_comment: Golden vectors for the candidate identity spec (identity_spec_version 1, ADR-0054). Promoted from control/tests/test_configrepo.py; drift-locked by control/tests/test_candidate.py, which recomputes every expected value through the production formula. A consumer implementing independent verification must reproduce every expected value from 'fields' alone.

algorithm.summary: Candidate identity is the triple (base image digest, instruction hash, adapter name); the instruction hash is sha256 over the canonical JSON of the identity mapping (ADR-0045/0052, BENCH-CONTRACT.md).
algorithm.identity_keys: Exactly: base (the digest-pinned image ref), setup (the MATERIALIZED setup: the operator's instructions plus, when model or effort is set, one synthesized 'theozolith-adapter materialize --adapter <a> [--model <m>] [--effort <e>] --scope <scope>' instruction — managed scope for driver types, interactive for driverless; values shell-quoted, single-space joined), knowledge (the BAKED knowledge ref: '' for driverless types), knowledge_pin (the compiled tree's content hash, '' when nothing bakes) — plus knowledge_target ONLY when it is non-empty and differs from the default /home/ozolith/.claude/ (the ADR-0052 conditional key: pre-existing claude identities stay byte-stable).
algorithm.canonicalization: json.dumps(identity, sort_keys=True) with Python's DEFAULT separators (', ' and ': ') — NOT the compact form; UTF-8 encoded, sha256 hex digest.
algorithm.excluded: driver reference, workspace, secret slots, worker-type name (the name enters the tag, never the hash), adapter (enters the triple directly and, indirectly, the rendered materialize instruction and the conditional knowledge_target).
algorithm.tag: theozolith/<worker-type-name>:<base-tag>-<instruction_hash[:12]> where <base-tag> is the tag component of the base ref before '@' ('latest' when bare).
algorithm.knowledge_tree_hash: The knowledge pin is sha256 over the compact JSON (separators ',' ':') of the sorted list of [relpath, sha256(file bytes) hex, mode] entries, where relpath is POSIX-relative to the tree root and mode is '755' for executable files, '644' otherwise; '' for a missing or empty tree. Symlinks and special files are refused, never skipped.

vectors.name: claude-no-knowledge
vectors.description: Driverless, no model/effort, no knowledge: identity is base + setup with empty knowledge fields and no materialize instruction (promoted from control/tests/test_configrepo.py::test_tag_without_model_is_golden_stable).

vectors.name: claude-model-knowledge-default-target
vectors.description: Driver type, claude adapter, model set, knowledge baked to the DEFAULT claude target: the materialize instruction enters the setup and the default knowledge_target is OMITTED from the canonical identity (ADR-0052 conditional key; promoted from test_configrepo.py::test_tag_with_model_is_golden_over_the_materialized_setup).

expected.canonical_identity: {"base": "ghcr.io/snowfoxbuilds/theozolith-run-claude:0.3.0@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", "knowledge": "knowledge/gold", "knowledge_pin": "1a7090eb2377900ecf12c6d8ccd2d44ad9e843bd2e4fc660b80f332d1fc77a05", "setup": ["apt-get update && apt-get install -y ripgrep", "theozolith-adapter materialize --adapter claude --model claude-sonnet-5 --scope managed"]}

vectors.name: claude-model-effort
vectors.description: Model AND effort materialization: both flags render into the one synthesized managed-scope materialize instruction, which is identity-bearing.

materialized_setup: theozolith-adapter materialize --adapter claude --model claude-opus-5 --effort high --scope managed

vectors.name: codex-non-default-target
vectors.description: Codex adapter baking knowledge: the non-default knowledge_target /home/ozolith/.codex/ IS a Dockerfile byte and enters the canonical identity (ADR-0052). Effort stays empty (the codex effort capability table is empty until spike #76 S7).

expected.canonical_identity: {"base": "ghcr.io/snowfoxbuilds/theozolith-run-codex:0.3.0@sha256:cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc", "knowledge": "knowledge/gold", "knowledge_pin": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb", "knowledge_target": "/home/ozolith/.codex/", "setup": ["apt-get update && apt-get install -y ripgrep", "theozolith-adapter materialize --adapter codex --model gpt-5.2-codex --scope managed"]}
